hypothesis_under_attack.conditional_route: F -> REDUCE -> F* ; BA25 runtime poly(N)*2^O(tau(F*))

moving_goalpost_firewall.repair_policy: Any implementation/specification defect is preserved append-only. A corrected experiment requires a new preregistration version; R0 is never rewritten.

frozen_cycle: R33 simplify under its sealed rule order
if R33 reaches EMPTY_CNF_SAT / EMPTY_CLAUSE_UNSAT / HORN / 2CNF, stop at that declared terminal
otherwise run R34 complete affine-CNF recognition; if recognized, solve GF(2) and verify certificate
otherwise run R35B single-literal RUP vivification and independent certificate replay
restart the exact same cycle only if the canonical formula changed
stop at exact portfolio fixpoint if no stage changes the formula

q_Horn.reason: Existing R39 authority is exact local membership/rejection for the one sealed R38 residual and explicitly does NOT claim a general polynomial recognizer.
q_Horn.policy: q-Horn may be recorded as historical local evidence but cannot classify new family residuals as a frozen general tractable terminal in R0.

BA25_engine.use: peak-state diagnostic where a verified supplied decomposition is available

width_certificate_contract.graph: CNF variable-clause incidence graph unless a lane explicitly records an additional factor graph; H1 tau is interpreted consistently on the declared incidence graph before and after reduction.

upper_bound.candidate_generation: deterministic min-fill elimination order is permitted only to propose a decomposition
upper_bound.reported_value: UB = max_bag_size_minus_1 of the validated decomposition

methods: degeneracy/core lower bound with replayable peel certificate
minor-min-width lower bound with replayable edge-contraction sequence and per-minor minimum-degree ledger
lower_bound.reported_value: LB = maximum of independently replayed valid lower bounds
lower_bound.exact_treewidth_rule: tau may be called exact only when independently certified LB == verified TD UB

width_certificate_contract.analytic_H3_extension: An eventual Omega(n^alpha) family theorem may use a separately proved expansion/separator/minor lower bound, but that theorem must be frozen and independently checked; finite LB measurements are not asymptotic authority.

truth_oracle_separation.SAT_authority: explicit total assignment evaluated directly against the exact original canonical CNF; residual witness additionally reconstructed to original CNF when reduction changes variables or clauses
truth_oracle_separation.UNSAT_authority: proof-producing solver is an untrusted producer; UNSAT is accepted only with an independently checked proof certificate, LRAT preferred or an equivalently audited exact proof format
truth_oracle_separation.tool_pinning: Exact proof-producer/checker bytes must be pinned in a separate PREEXECUTION_TRUTH_ORACLE_PINNING receipt before the first family instance is generated. That receipt may not change this preregistration, the reducer, terminal catalogue, families, signs, or schedules.
truth_oracle_separation.no_postselection: Every scheduled generated instance is retained with its actual certified truth status. A blind candidate that turns out SAT remains SAT; it is never discarded or reseeded to obtain UNSAT.

deterministic_generator_primitives.canonical_hash: SHA-256 over UTF-8 strings exactly as specified, lowercase hexadecimal digest

HASH_CONFIG_3.initial_clauses: sorted token stream cut into consecutive triples
collision_repair: scan clauses in increasing clause index
if a clause repeats a variable, choose the leftmost offending token
swap it with the lexicographically earliest later token position whose swap makes the current clause contain three distinct variables
if the resulting current variable triple duplicates an earlier clause, continue to the next admissible later token
later affected clauses are repaired when their turn is reached
if no admissible swap exists, emit GENERATOR_INTEGRITY_FAIL for that scheduled n; do not change seed and do not skip silently
HASH_CONFIG_3.degree_preservation: token swaps preserve exact variable occurrence degree d

families.generator: variables x_0..x_(n-1). SAT variant encodes x_i <-> x_(i+1) for all cyclic edges using the two standard width-2 implication clauses. UNSAT variant encodes x_i <-> x_(i+1) for i=0..n-2 and x_(n-1) <-> NOT x_0 on the closing edge.
families.truth: SAT variant has all-zero and all-one witnesses; UNSAT variant has an analytic parity contradiction.

families.generator: clauses (-x_i OR -x_(i+1) OR x_(i+2)) for i=0..n-3. SAT variant additionally has units x_0 and x_1. UNSAT variant adds unit -x_(n-1) to the SAT variant.
families.truth: SAT witness is all true; UNSAT follows by Horn forward implication from x_0,x_1 to x_(n-1) against -x_(n-1).

families.generator: start from the unit-free width-3 Horn chain (-x_i OR -x_(i+1) OR x_(i+2)); complement every occurrence of x_i iff i mod 3 == 0.
families.truth: transport the all-false witness through the fixed variable-complement map.

families.generator: use the 3-regular circular-ladder graph C_k Cartesian-product K_2; Boolean variables are graph edges; impose one parity equation on the three incident edge variables at every graph vertex and encode each parity equation by its complete width-3 CNF bundle. SAT charge vector has even total parity; UNSAT charge vector is identical except one fixed vertex charge is toggled, making total parity odd.
families.truth: Tseitin charge-sum theorem plus exact GF(2) certificate; SAT witness must also be reconstructed and directly checked.

families.generator: NO_GENERATION: replay the already sealed R38 source/fixpoint only

base_generator.incidence: (15,3)-regular simple bipartite variable-clause graph if generator integrity passes
base_generator.connectivity_status: EXPANDER_LIKE_STRESS_CANDIDATE_ONLY; no expansion theorem is assumed from hashing or observed spectral behavior

sign_cohorts.sign_rule: for token occurrence index r in 0..14 use positive for r=0..6 and negative for r=7..14, then complement all 15 signs of variable v iff the low bit of SHA256('JANUS-B1-VFLIP|'+decimal(n)+'|'+decimal(v)) is 1
sign_cohorts.property: every variable has both polarities with exact 7/8 or 8/7 split
sign_cohorts.truth: BLIND; label only from independent certificate pipeline

sign_cohorts.repair_to_satisfy_plant: if a clause is false under A, flip exactly one literal at position integer_value_of_first_byte(SHA256('JANUS-B2-FIX|'+decimal(n)+'|'+decimal(clause_index))) mod 3
sign_cohorts.truth: SAT by frozen explicit planted assignment; direct original-CNF validation required

required_graph_diagnostics: spectral or edge-expansion estimates may be recorded as heuristic diagnostics only
certified treewidth LB/UB interval is authoritative
LANE_B_ADVERSARIAL_GENERAL_3CNF.primary_analytic_target: If a subsequence survives essentially unchanged, attempt to prove a whole-family reduction-stall lemma plus a separator/expansion/minor theorem yielding tau(residual)=Omega(n^alpha).

LANE_C_STRUCTURED_NP_HARD_STRESS.hardness_scope: The source problem class Cubic Monotone 1-in-3 SAT is selected as a bounded-occurrence NP-hard/NP-complete stress source. The specific deterministic subsequences below are not themselves asserted NP-hard without a separate theorem.

CNF_encoding.if_source_hypergraph_is_cubic: each source variable occurs in exactly 3 exact-one constraints and exactly 9 encoded CNF literal occurrences

cohorts.hypergraph_generator: HASH_CONFIG_3 with seed_string='JANUS-USF-R0-LANE-C-CUBIC' and d=3; each simple triple is one monotone exact-one constraint
cohorts.truth: BLIND; retain every scheduled instance with independently certified SAT/UNSAT status

cohorts.plant: choose n/3 true variables as the first n/3 variable ids in SHA256('JANUS-C2-TRUESET|'+decimal(n)+'|'+decimal(v)) rank order; remaining 2n/3 are false
cohorts.construction: create 3 occurrence tokens for every variable. Hash-sort true tokens and false tokens independently. Each of the n exact-one clauses receives one true token and two false tokens. Repair repeated false-variable pairs and duplicate triples by the same earliest-valid later-token swap rule, without changing degrees. Integrity failure is retained and never reseeded.
cohorts.truth: SAT by the frozen exact-one planted assignment; direct source exact-one and encoded-CNF validation required

per_instance_required_record: generator integrity status and generator-spec version
complete ordered reduction-step ledger with rule id, before/after hash and (C,L,V)
terminal classification under frozen C_USF_R0 only
verified tree-decomposition upper bound UB and full TD validation receipt
independently replayed treewidth lower bound LB and certificate
exact truth certificate status separated from reducer
BA25 tau used and peak-state count where a verified decomposition is feasible

strong_backdoor_diagnostic.definition: minimum |B| such that for every assignment rho to B, canonical restriction F*|rho is recognized by at least one frozen catalogue member
strong_backdoor_diagnostic.exact_search_policy_where_feasible: enumerate subsets by cardinality then lexicographic variable order; for each subset enumerate all assignments lexicographically; first successful cardinality is exact only after all smaller subsets have been exhaustively rejected
reporting: if exact minimum found, record b_C and complete strong-backdoor certificate
if all subsets through k are rejected, record only certified lower bound b_C > k
otherwise record NOT_COMPUTED; heuristic backdoors are never labeled minimum

holdout_policy.meaning: holdout sizes cannot influence reducer, terminal catalogue, family generator, sign rules, or proposed analytic theorem
holdout_policy.release_rule: do not execute holdout sizes until any candidate family-level theorem or separator-destruction lemma statement, constants, and proof obligations have been frozen in a separate append-only candidate-theorem preregistration
holdout_policy.failure_rule: a holdout failure is preserved; no reseeding, schedule substitution, or family repair is allowed inside R0

required: explicit infinite family definition fixed independently of measured outcomes
proof valid for every admissible n in the family
explicit constants c,d with tau(REDUCE(F_n)) <= c*log2(n)+d
independent proof or certificate replay where computational components occur
the exact frozen R0 reducer maps F_n to F_n*
analytic theorem tau(F_n*) = Omega(n^alpha) for explicit alpha>0
F_n* avoids every member of C_USF_R0 under frozen recognizers
lower-bound theorem applies to the canonical residual itself, not merely to a heuristic width estimate
no postselection or reseeding based on results
H1_falsification_by_H3.consequence: falsifies H1 for this frozen reducer only

successful_collapse_promotion.required: symbolic whole-family lemma plus independently checked hypotheses; empirical width drop alone is insufficient

anti_artifact_firewalls.tautologies_and_duplicate_literals: canonicalize exactly before measurement and record removals in the reduction ledger
anti_artifact_firewalls.duplicate_clauses: canonicalize under the frozen reducer semantics and record any collapse
anti_artifact_firewalls.disconnected_padding: may be measured but cannot be the primary H3 promotion witness unless the lower-bound-bearing component is itself semantically retained by the canonical residual; no synthetic satisfiable padding is introduced by these generators for the purpose of inflating width
